environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP) and performs no request inspection. Traffic flows: Client -> NLB (TCP passthrough) -> EC2:8080 (Flask/Gunicorn). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application database contains the products table and a separate api_keys table with key hashes and owner information. No additional middleware or proxy between NLB and application.
